ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a cumulative proportion curve; the horizontal axis is labeled Dollars per acre, with tick marks approximately at 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000; the vertical axis is a cumulative proportion scale, from 0.2 to 1.0. The curve starts rising from around 1000 dollars/acre and gradually approaches 1.0 as land value increases. Reasoning: The median corresponds to 0.5 in the cumulative distribution, that is, the position where the vertical-axis cumulative proportion is 0.5. Looking horizontally from 0.5 on the vertical axis to the curve, then projecting downward to the horizontal axis, the intersection is approximately at 2000 dollars/acre. Therefore the median land value is about 2000 dollars/acre.

raw_record.question_text: The graph below shows cumulative proportions plotted against land values (in dollars per acre) for farms on sale in a rural community. What is the median land value?

method.method_draft: Read the graph as an ogive/cumulative distribution. From the image, locate cumulative proportion 0.5 on the vertical axis, draw or imagine a horizontal line to the plotted curve, then project straight down to the dollars-per-acre axis. The intersection falls at about 2000 dollars per acre, so the median land value is $2000.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一条累积比例曲线，横轴标为 Dollars per acre，刻度大约有 1000、2000、3000、4000；纵轴为累积比例刻度，从 0.2 到 1.0。曲线从约 1000 美元/英亩附近开始上升，并随着土地价值增加而逐渐接近 1.0。推理：中位数对应累积分布中的 0.5，也就是纵轴累计比例为 0.5 的位置。从纵轴 0.5 处水平看向曲线，再向下投影到横轴，交点大约在 2000 美元/英亩处。因此中位土地价值约为 2000 美元/英亩。
